EN:
You again, huh?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0006:}}Well, don't just
stand there.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} Find a seat and have
some coffee already!
ES:
Ah, ¿tú otra vez?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0006:}}Bueno, no te
quedes ahí de pie.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} Siéntate y
te tomas un café o algo.
FR:
Tiens, te revoilà ?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0006:}}Eh bien, ne reste
pas planté{{TAG:000E:0006:000002006500}} là.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} Pose ton derrière sur
une chaise et commande un café !
IT:
Di nuovo tu, eh?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0006:}}Beh, non startene
lì impalat{{TAG:000E:0006:02006F0002006100}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} Mettiti a sedere e
prenditi un caffè, no?
TRANSLATION:
Yine sen,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0006:}} ha? Dikilip durma;{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}
otur da kahveni iç artık!

EN:
You again!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} I've been seein' your
face a whole lot lately!
FR:
Encore toi !{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} On se voit souvent ces
temps-ci, dis-moi !
IT:
Di nuovo tu!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Ultimamente
ci vediamo spesso, eh?
DE:
Du schon wieder!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Dich seh ich in
letzter Zeit ziemlich oft!
TRANSLATION:
Yine sen!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Son zamanlarda yüzünü
bayağı sık görüyorum!

EN:
When it comes to coffee,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} I don't
drink anything other than {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Blue
Mountain{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}!{{TAG:0007:0000:04000000}} That's it!
For aroma,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} richness,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} and sweetness,{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}there's nothing even close to better
than Blue Mountain beans!
{{TAG:0003:0000:}}Er,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} I mean we all have different
tastes,{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}} so I suppose I could see
how you might like something else.
FR:
Je ne bois qu'une seule sorte de
café :{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} le {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Blue Mountain {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}!{{TAG:0007:0000:04000000}} Personne
ne me fera boire autre chose !
Cet arôme,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} cette richesse,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} cette
douceur...{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} Le {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Blue Mountain{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}, c'est
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}un café grand cru !
{{TAG:0003:0000:}}Enfin,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} il y a autant de goûts que
d'individus,{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}} alors tu préféreras
peut-être une autre sorte.
DE:
Außer {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Schonröstung{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} kommt mir kein
anderer Kaffee in die Tasse.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Da
lasse ich nicht mit mir handeln!
An dieses Aroma, den vollen
Geschmack und die leichte Süße
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}kommt nichts ran!
{{TAG:0003:0000:}}Na ja, kann sein, dass jemand
einen anderen Geschmack hat.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
Hab schon Seltsameres gesehen...
TRANSLATION:
Kahve denince Blue{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} Mountain
dışında hiçbir{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}} şey{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} içmem{{TAG:0007:0000:04000000}}! Nokta!
Koku{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}, gövde{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}, tatlılık{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}}... Blue
Mountain çekirdeğine yaklaşan
yok!{{TAG:0003:0000:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} Yani... zevkler farklı
tabii{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}; başka bir şeyi
sevebilirsin herhâlde.

ES:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Ponerle leche al café{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} {{TAG:0003:0028:}}echa a perder
todo su aroma y su sabor.{{TAG:0007:0000:04000000}} ¡Un café
está siempre mejor {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}sin{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} leche!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0000:}}Ya, ya,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} es solo mi opinión, claro.{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}
Yo respeto a los insensatos
que lo prefieren con leche.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Ajouter du lait au café,{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} {{TAG:0003:0028:}}ça revient à
altérer son arôme et son goût.{{TAG:0007:0000:04000000}} Les
puristes le boivent {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}sans{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} lait !{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0000:}}Nan nan,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} ne t'inquiète pas, je ne
critique pas tes habitudes...{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}} Même si
c'est du n'importe quoi...
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Wenn du mich fragst,{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} {{TAG:0003:0028:}}Milch im
Kaffee zerstört das Aroma.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Kaffee
trinkt man {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}ohne {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}Milch!
{{TAG:0003:0000:}}Ich will dir nicht sagen, wie du
deinen Kaffee trinken sollst.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Aber du
solltest wie immer auf mich hören.
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Kahveye süt eklemek{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}}{{TAG:0003:0028:}} kokusunu ve
tadını bozar.{{TAG:0007:0000:04000000}} Kahve sütsüz en{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}
iyisidir{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0000:}}! Evet{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} evet, senin nasıl
içtiğine karışmıyorum. Gerçi{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}} az
önce karıştım.

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Sugar in your coffee?{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}
{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}No way{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}! You CRAZY?!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:001B:}}You use something like that,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} you
won't be able to taste the natural
sweetness of your coffee!
{{TAG:0003:0000:}}All right,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} maybe you're the kind that
needs your coffee even sweeter.{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}
To each 'is own, I suppose.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}¿Ponerle azúcar al café?{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}
¡{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Ni una pizca{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}! ¿Te has vuelto loc{{TAG:000E:0006:02006F0002006100}}?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}¿Qué interés tiene un café{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} si
ha perdido su sabor natural?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0000:}}Pero bueno,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} si te gusta con azúcar,
se la puedes poner.{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}} Yo no me meto
si lo quieres arruinar.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Du sucre dans le café ?{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}
{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}JAMAIS {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}! T'es malade ?!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:001B:}}En rajoutant du sucre,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} tu masques
la douceur naturelle de ton café !
C'est une hérésie !
{{TAG:0003:0000:}}Bon,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} c'est ton café après tout. {{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}Tu le
préfères peut-être plus sucré. Il faut
de tout pour faire un monde.
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Zucchero nel caffè?{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}
No dico, scherziamo?!
{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Niente zucchero{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}!
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Se metti lo zucchero,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} non sarai
in grado di sentire la naturale
dolcezza del caffè!
{{TAG:0003:0000:}}Ah, ho capito.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} A te piace prenderlo
dolce, eh?{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}} Beh, a ognuno il suo...
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Zucker im Kaffee?{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}} {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Niemals{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Wer
kommt denn auf solche Ideen?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Da geht doch der eigentliche
Geschmack des Kaffees völlig
flöten!
{{TAG:0003:0000:}}Na, aber jeder soll's so machen, wie
er will! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Ich bin jedenfalls auch so
schon süß genug.

EN:
Nowadays,{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} {{TAG:0003:0006:}}there are WAY too many
grown-ups who do pretty much
anything they're told to do!
{{TAG:0003:0028:}}Can you even imagine the chaos that
occurs if a bunch of older guys start
doin' stuff the young guys say?
{{TAG:0003:0000:}}There are times you gotta stick to
your own beliefs,{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} even if you know
you're in the wrong.
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}I wanna continue being that kind of
opinionated old man people usually
tend to avoid.{{TAG:0007:0000:04000000}} That's for me!
ES:
Ahora a mucha gente mayor{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} le {{TAG:0003:0006:}}ha
dado por la moda de los cambios
y la modernidad. ¡Lo que faltaba!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0028:}}¿Qué sería de nosotros{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} si todos
empezáramos a hacer tonterías
sin sentido como los jóvenes?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0000:}}Es importante tener personalidad
y defender tus propias opiniones,{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}}
aunque estés equivocado.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Este viejo cabezota{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} no piensa
cambiar sus costumbres{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} por cuatro
modas pasajeras.{{TAG:0007:0000:04000000}} ¡Es lo que hay!
FR:
De nos jours,{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} {{TAG:0003:0006:}}certains adultes
suivent n'importe quel ordre sans
se poser de questions !
{{TAG:0003:0028:}}Si ça continue, nos ancêtres vont se
mettre à obéir aux jeunots sans
expérience...
{{TAG:0003:0000:}}Parfois, il faut savoir défendre ses
convictions,{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} qu'elles soient
justifiées ou non.
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Moi, je serai toujours un vieux
ronchon têtu qui fait peur à tout le
monde.{{TAG:0007:0000:04000000}} C'est ma nature !
IT:
Al giorno d'oggi{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} {{TAG:0003:0006:}}ci sono troppi
adulti che fanno qualsiasi cosa
gli venga detto di fare!
{{TAG:0003:0028:}}È terribile! Cosa accadrebbe se
gli adulti iniziassero a fare quello
che gli dicono i ragazzini?
{{TAG:0003:0000:}}La società si distruggerebbe!{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}}
Noi adulti dobbiamo mantenere
le nostre convinzioni!
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Voglio diventare uno di quei vecchi
brontoloni che la gente cerca
sempre di evitare.{{TAG:0007:0000:04000000}} Proprio così!
DE:
Heutzutage{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} {{TAG:0003:0006:}}tun viel zu viele einfach
alles, was man ihnen sagt, ohne
groß nachzufragen!
{{TAG:0003:0028:}}Man muss auch mal zu seiner
Meinung stehen und sein Ding
durchziehen!
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Oh, ich weiß genau, was jetzt in
deinen Gehirnwindungen vor sich
geht, du kleines Genie.
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Ein paar grundlegende Sachen
hinterfragt man eben nicht, und
dazu gehört ordentliches Speichern!
TRANSLATION:
Bugünlerde{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}}{{TAG:0003:0006:}} söylenen her şeyi
yapan ÇOK fazla yetişkin var!
Yaşlı{{TAG:0003:0028:}} adamların gençlerin her
dediğini yapmasının yaratacağı
kaosu düşünsene! Bazen yanlış{{TAG:0003:0000:}}
olduğunu bilsen bile kendi
inancına{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} tutunman gerekir. Ben
de insanların{{TAG:0003:0006:}} özellikle
kaçındığı o inatçı ihtiyar
olarak kalacağım. Bana{{TAG:0007:0000:04000000}} bu yakışır!

EN:
"{{TAG:0000:0003:0400}}Mr. Resetti{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}},{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0003:0006:}}he's always angry and
just yells at people...{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0000:}}"But that {{TAG:0000:0003:0400}}Don Resetti{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}, he's always
calm,{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} {{TAG:0003:0015:}}peaceful,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} and friendly to
everybody he meets{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}."
{{TAG:0003:0000:}}That's probably what you think of
us,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} huh?{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}} {{TAG:0003:0024:}}But that ain't right!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0022:}}My brother is very persistent when
he gives his endless lectures!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0000:}}Ever been lectured for two hours
long? Yeah, even I'm not THAT bad!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:001B:}}In the end,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} you'll probably forget
why you were even being lectured
in the first place!
I'm just sayin', {{TAG:0003:0028:}}ya shouldn't judge
a book by its cover! And that goes
DOUBLE for moles!
ES:
"Ese {{TAG:0000:0003:0400}}Rese T. Ado{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0003:0006:}}siempre anda
enfadado y pegándole gritos a
la gente..."{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0000:}}"Pero el hermano, {{TAG:0000:0003:0400}}Forma T. Ado{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}},{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}es muy tranquilo{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} y simpático con
todo el mundo{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}."
{{TAG:0003:0000:}}¿A que es eso lo que piensas de
nosotros,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} eh?{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}} {{TAG:0003:0024:}}¡Pues te equivocas!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0022:}}¡Mi hermano también es muy
pesado{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} cuando se pone a dar uno
de sus sermones interminables!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0000:}}¿Alguna vez te han echado la bronca
durante dos horas?{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} Pues imagínate.
Ni siquiera yo soy tan malo.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Cuando termine de darte la brasa{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}
seguro que ya ni te acordarás de
por qué se había enfadado.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Así que {{TAG:0003:0028:}}cuidado con dejarte llevar
por las apariencias.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} ¡No todo es
lo que parece!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}« {{TAG:0000:0003:0400}}M. Resetti{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}},{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0003:0006:}}il ne fait rien que
hurler et martyriser tout le monde...{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0026:}}{{TAG:0000:0003:0400}}Don Resetti{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}, par contre, il est
tellement sympa,{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} {{TAG:0003:0015:}}calme,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} et cool
envers tout le monde{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}. »
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}C'est ce que tu penses aussi, hein ?
{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}Hein ?{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}} {{TAG:0003:0024:}}Laisse-moi te dire que c'est
n'importe quoi !{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0022:}}Mon frère est un pro des discours
interminables, et tu as intérêt à
rester jusqu'au bout !{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Les discours de deux heures, je t'en
ai déjà fait, moi ? Non, parce que je
ne suis pas aussi cruel que lui !{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:001B:}}D'ailleurs,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} à la fin du discours, tu
auras certainement oublié pourquoi
tu es là !
J'dis ça, j'dis rien, {{TAG:0003:0028:}}mais l'habit ne
fait pas le moine, tout comme le
discours ne fait pas la taupe !
IT:
"Il signor{{TAG:0000:0003:0400}} Resetti{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0003:0006:}}è sempre
arrabbiato e grida a tutti..."{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0000:}}"Ah, quel {{TAG:0000:0003:0400}}Don Resetti{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}, invece...
Lui sì che è sempre{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} {{TAG:0003:0015:}}tranquillo
e amichevole con tutti{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}."
{{TAG:0003:0000:}}È quello che pensi tu di noi,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} vero?{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0024:}}Beh, le cose non stanno
affatto così!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0022:}}Mio fratello se vuole è in grado
di farti una testa così, altroché!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0000:}}Ti ha mai fatto un sermone
di due ore? Nemmeno io la faccio
così lunga, no?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Alla fine,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} probabilmente non
ricordi nemmeno più perché
ti sta sgridando!
Tutto quello che voglio dire
è{{TAG:0003:0028:}} che non bisogna fidarsi
delle apparenze!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Soprattutto se si parla di talpe!
DE:
„{{TAG:0000:0003:0400}}Signor Resetti{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} {{TAG:0003:0006:}}ist immer so mies
gelaunt und schreit immer gleich
durch die Gegend...“
{{TAG:0003:0000:}}„Aber sein Bruder {{TAG:0000:0003:0400}}Don{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} ist die Ruhe
selbst,{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} {{TAG:0003:0015:}}friedfertig und immer sooo
nett...“
{{TAG:0003:0000:}}Na, so in der Art denkste dir das
doch, oder?{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}} {{TAG:0003:0024:}}Aber da hast du schief
getunnelt!
{{TAG:0003:0013:}}Auf seine Weise kann mein Bruder
jemanden genauso zermürben!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0000:}}Hast du dir schon mal zwei Stunden
lang Vorhaltungen angehört? {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
Dagegen fasse ich mich kurz!
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Am Ende weißt du nicht mal mehr,
warum er überhaupt angefangen hat,
dir einen Vortrag zu halten!
Was ich sagen will: {{TAG:0003:0028:}}Man sollte
immer zweimal hinsehen! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Es ist
nicht alles, wie es scheint!
TRANSLATION:
'Bay{{TAG:0000:0003:0400}}{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} Resetti{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0003:0006:}} hep kızgın, sürekli
bağırıyor{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0000:}}...'{{TAG:0000:0003:0400}} 'Ama Don{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} Resetti
sakin{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}}, barışçıl{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} ve herkese
dostça..{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.'{{TAG:0003:0000:}} Bizi böyle
düşünüyorsun,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} değil{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}{{TAG:0003:0024:}} mi? Yanlış!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0022:}}
Abim ders vermeye başladı mı
sonsuza kadar{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0000:}} sürdürür! İki saat
azar işittin mi hiç? Ben bile{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:001B:}} O
KADAR{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} kötü değilim! Sonunda niye
azar yediğini unutursun. Kitabı
kapağına{{TAG:0003:0028:}} göre yargılama;
köstebeklerde iki kere düşün!

EN:
When a mole moves through the
ground by diggin' a tunnel,{{TAG:0007:0000:04000000}} it's
actually slower than a snail moving.{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}}
You ever heard that before?{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}}{{TAG:0000:0004:}}I've never actually raced a snail
to find out,{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} {{TAG:0003:0028:}}so I don't know if it's
true or not{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}But just think about it!{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} I'm diggin'
a tunnel through DIRT and ROCKS,
while the snail's just MOVIN'!
{{TAG:0003:0000:}}It's nonsense to compare us!
Diggin' a hole wide enough {{TAG:0003:0006:}}to pass
through with a pickax is HARD!{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0000:}}By the way,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} I already dug a tunnel
to your house,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} so in case I need to,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}I can be there in an INSTANT!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
I plan for every eventuality!
ES:
Cuando un topo cava un túnel,{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}}
avanza al mismo ritmo que camina
un caracol.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}¿No habías oído nunca antes esa
comparación?{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}}{{TAG:0000:0004:}}El caso es que nunca he echado
una carrera contra un caracol,{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0028:}}así que no sé si será verdad{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Pero párate a pensar.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} ¡Cavar a
través de tierra y rocas no tiene
nada que ver con solo caminar!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0000:}}¡Ni siquiera se puede comparar!{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}
¡No es nada fácil hacer un túnel lo
bastante ancho{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0003:0006:}} con solo un pico!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0000:}}A propósito:{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} ya he hecho uno que
llega hasta tu casa.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} Cuando necesite
verte,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0003:0006:}}¡estaré allí en un pispás!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Il paraît qu'une taupe avance moins
vite qu'un escargot{{TAG:0007:0000:04000000}} quand elle
creuse un tunnel.{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}Tu le savais ?{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}}{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0000:}}Je n'ai jamais fait la course avec un
escargot,{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} {{TAG:0003:0028:}}alors je ne sais pas si
c'est juste une légende{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Mais la comparaison est INJUSTE !{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}
Moi, je creuse à travers terre et roc
alors que l'escargot, il rampe !
{{TAG:0003:0000:}}Qui a eu l'idée stupide de nous
comparer ? {{TAG:0003:0006:}}Quelqu'un qui n'a jamais
fait de travaux forcés, pour sûr !{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}
